Name: Your and Hovsep's Takoyaki
Author: BlackWithWhite
Description:
[b]七宗罪NPC霍夫塞普的孩子扩展mod 女孩男孩将会拥有属于自己的肖像，对话框

上百+对话支持多语言，中文，韩语，日语，英语，俄罗斯语，动态翻译！

黄色警告和红色错误补丁不用管

婴儿也可以对话，孩子会出去玩，你可以给它送礼，和它玩游戏，给它做东西吃，让它跟着你，它会和居民们相处融洽

日程完全随机，路程随机，你可以在各种地方碰到孩子（章鱼不能去沙漠）

支持多婚，不确定是否兼容手机版！

务必阅读里面的说明，会告诉你关于这个mod的游玩须知。

该mod不开源，不允许盈利并且二次传播[/b]

[b]如果孩子的对话框有位置上的问题或者根本见不到，务必调一下游戏的窗口！
————————————————————
Seven Deadly Sins NPC Hrothseph's Child Expansion Mod

The child will have their own portrait, dialogue box, and hundreds of lines of dialogue.

Supports multiple languages: Chinese, Korean, Japanese, English, Russian — dynamic translation!

As a baby, you can talk to the child. The child will go out to play. You can give them gifts, play games with them, cook food for them, and have them follow you. They will get along well with the other villagers.

Their schedule is completely random, and their pathfinding is also random. You can encounter the child in many different places (octopus children cannot go to the desert).

Supports multiple spouses. Mobile compatibility is uncertain.

Please be sure to read the in‑mod instructions — they contain important information about how to play with this mod.

This mod is not open source. Redistribution for profit and secondary distribution are not allowed.[/b]

[b]If the child's dialogue box has positioning issues or is completely invisible, be sure to adjust the game window![/b]
[b]——————————————————————————————————————————————————————[/b]
[b]因为我并没有学过代码，但是又很想制作模组，所以代码使用了AI辅助去生成和调试，美术绘制和对话文案则是我本人负责。[/b]
[b]尽管代码使用了AI，但是我的调试和摸索也耗费了大量精力，历时了很长的时间，所以才没有进行开源。[/b]
[b]感谢用户 AnotherPillow 提醒我在模组界面声明这个！在那之前我只在 TXT 里声明了我用了 AI 去生成代码。
[/b]
[b]I haven't actually learned to code, but I really wanted to make a mod, so I used AI to generate and debug the code. The art and dialogue writing were all done by me personally.[/b]
[b]Even though the code was AI-assisted, I still put a lot of time and effort into debugging and trial-and-error — which is why I haven't open-sourced it.[/b]
[b]Thanks to AnotherPillow for reminding me to put this on the mod page! I had only mentioned it in the TXT file before.[/b]

[b]SMAPI红色补丁错误和黄色警告是正常的！不影响游戏！请阅读文件夹内的说明文档！解压mod以后，点开mod看文件夹里面的说明TXT！[/b]

[b]SMAPI red patch errors and yellow warnings are completely normal! They do not affect the game in any way! Please read the documentation inside the folder! After extracting the mod, open the folder and read the instruction TXT files inside![/b]

[b]我做的七宗罪孩子之间互相兼容！[/b]

[b]All of the Seven Deadly Sins children I've made are fully compatible with each other![/b]

我在意的，完全就是你连吱一声都没有！真的很没有礼貌，太自私了！

 This mod is only published on Nexus Mods! No redistribution permissions have been granted whatsoever! Some platforms, such as 3DM, have been re-uploading this mod without authorization. If you come across such cases, please help report them!

I want to reiterate: this mod was created out of love for a mod that I truly enjoy! It will never be used for any commercial or profit-making purposes. Whether or not you credit the original creator's name, reposting without asking for permission first is extremely disrespectful to the author! Even worse, some have gone so far as to bundle it into mod packs! I know downloading from Nexus Mods might require a few extra steps, but this is a platform that actually protects authors' rights — unlike certain other platforms that do absolutely no vetting and allow anyone to freely re-upload content just to drive traffic and attention to their sites! That's one of the reasons I only publish on Nexus Mods!

What bothers me the most is simply that you didn't even bother to ask! It's incredibly rude and so selfish!
